basic.name: 普通攻击：横行斩打
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多六段的斩击，造成物理伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 6 slashes ahead, dealing Physical DMG.

special.name: 特殊技：震荡盾击
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
使用盾牌向前方进行打击，造成物理伤害；
若在招式发动初期的较短时间内受到敌方攻击，将触发[精准格挡]，抵挡此次攻击伤害，并自动衔接发动[特殊技：喧嚣直刺]；
招式发动后，凯撒将进入格挡架势，期间自身受到的伤害降低40%，受到敌人攻击时将持盾格挡并被击退，随后点按 【特殊技键】 或 【强化特殊技键】 ，可以触发[防御反击]，发动[特殊技：喧嚣直刺]或[强化特殊技：超强力盾击]；
触发[防御反击]时，招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Strike forward with the shield, dealing Physical DMG.
If Caesar is hit by an enemy at the beginning of the skill's activation, it will trigger a Perfect Block, negating the damage once and automatically following up with a Special Attack: Roaring Thrust.
After using the skill, Caesar enters a guard stance, reducing incoming damage by 40%. When attacked by an enemy, Caesar blocks with the shield and gets slightly knocked back. Press [Special Attack] or [EX Special Attack] to trigger Retaliation, activating Special Attack: Roaring Thrust or EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash
When Retaliation is triggered, Caesar is invulnerable while using the skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：招架反击
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
使用盾牌向前方进行打击，随后发动强力刺击，造成大量物理伤害；
若在招式发动初期受到敌方攻击，或通过盾牌打击触发[破招]时，将触发[精准格挡]，抵挡此次攻击伤害，并挥盾反击；触发[精准格挡]后，点按 【强化特殊技键】 ，可以发动[强化特殊技：超强力盾击]，且无需消耗能量；
招式发动后，凯撒将进入格挡架势，期间自身受到的伤害降低40%，受到敌人攻击时将持盾格挡并被击退，随后点按 【特殊技键】 或 【强化特殊技键】 ，可以触发[防御反击]，发动[特殊技：喧嚣直刺]或[强化特殊技：超强力盾击]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Strikes forward with the shield, followed by a powerful thrust, dealing massive Physical DMG.
If Caesar is hit by an enemy at the beginning of the skill activation or an Interrupt is triggered with the shield strike, it will trigger Perfect Block, negating incoming damage once and countering with a shield attack. After triggering Perfect Block, press [EX Special Attack] to activate EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash without consuming energy.
After using the skill, Caesar enters a guard stance, reducing incoming damage by 40%. When attacked by an enemy, Caesar blocks the attack and is knocked back. Press [Special Attack] or [EX Special Attack] to trigger Retaliation and activate Special Attack: Roaring Thrust or EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：以牙还牙
dodgeCounter.nameEn: Dodge Counter: Eye For an Eye
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动刺击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Stabs at enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：路怒震打
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
对前方范围敌人发动强力下落打击，造成大量物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful downward strike at enemies ahead, dealing massive Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：暴君猛击
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
丢出手中的盾牌对前方敌人发动强力旋转攻击，随后发动下落打击，造成大量物理伤害；
命中持有护盾的敌人时，招式造成的失衡值提升45%；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Tosses the shield forward, unleashing a powerful spinning attack on enemies in front, followed by a downward strike, dealing massive Physical DMG.
When hitting shielded enemies, the Daze dealt is increased by 45%.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：变道支援
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:

Thrust at enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：守御之盾
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：支援之锋
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:

招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:

After activating the skill, press [Special Attack] or [EX Special Attack] to trigger a Retaliation, activating Special Attack: Roaring Thrust or EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text:
凯撒发动[强化特殊技：招架反击]、[连携技]、[终结技]或以[防御反击]的方式发动[强化特殊技：超强力盾击]时，为全队提供等同于自身1400%初始冲击力+1400点的护盾[荣光之盾]，持续60秒，[荣光之盾]由当前操作中的角色持有，护盾值为全队共享，单次受到的伤害不会超过护盾值；
[荣光之盾]存在期间，持有者的抗打断等级提升；
[荣光之盾]存在期间，持有者的攻击力提升1000点，[荣光之盾]效果结束后，该增益效果仍然保留，持续5秒。
facts.textEn:
When Caesar activates EX Special Attack: Parry Counter, Chain Attack, Ultimate, or triggers EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash through Retaliation, she buffs all squad members with a Radiant Aegis shield equal to 1,400% of her base Impact + 1,400. The shield lasts for 60s and is equipped by the active character, with its value shared among all squad members. Any single instance of DMG will not exceed the shield value.
While Radiant Aegis is active, the shield bearer's Anti-Interrupt level is increased.
While Radiant Aegis is active, the shield bearer's ATK is increased by 1,000. After Radiant Aegis expires, this buff remains for an additional 5s.

cinema.name: 楔式进军
cinema.description: 成为接战状态下的当前操作角色时，凯撒立即为全队提供[荣光之盾]，300秒内最多触发一次；[荣光之盾]存在期间，持有者附近5米范围内敌人的全属性伤害抗性降低15%。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Caesar becomes the active character in combat, she instantly buffs all squad members with a Radiant Aegis shield. This effect can trigger once every 300s. While Radiant Aegis is active, enemies within a 5m radius of the shield bearer suffer a 15% All-Attribute RES reduction.

cinema.name: 异域传承
cinema.description: [核心被动：坚韧之壁]中，[荣光之盾]存在期间，凯撒的能量获得效率提升10%，持有者的攻击力提升效果提升至原本的150%。
cinema.descriptionEn: While Radiant Aegis from Core Passive: Barrier of Resilience is active, Caesar's Energy Generation Rate increases by 10%, and the shield bearer's ATK boost is increased to 150% of its original value.

cinema.name: 绝对信任
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 阿瑞斯攻城锤
cinema.description: 凯撒发动[连携技]或[终结技]时，额外回复3点[支援点数]；凯撒的能量值不足20点时，可以消耗1点[支援点数]作为代替，发动[强化特殊技：超强力盾击]，代替效果5秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Caesar uses a Chain Attack or Ultimate, she gains 3 additional Assist Points. If her Energy is below 20, she can activate EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash with 1 Assist Point instead. This substitution can trigger once every 5s.

cinema.name: 浪漫征伐
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 霸主之志
cinema.description: [强化特殊技：超强力盾击]和[支援突击：支援之锋]必定触发暴击，招式造成的伤害提升50%，对主要目标造成的伤害额外提升50%；凯撒发动[强化特殊技：超强力盾击]或[支援突击：支援之锋]时，自身暴击率提升30%，暴击伤害提升60%，持续15秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash and Assist Follow-Up: Aiding Blade are guaranteed to trigger a critical hit. The skill's DMG is increased by 50% and deals additional 50% DMG to the primary target. When Caesar uses EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash or Assist Follow-Up: Aiding Blade, her CRIT Rate is increased by 30% and her CRIT DMG is increased by 60% for 15s.

未触发[精准格挡]和[防御反击]时，招式发动期间抗打断等级提升；
触发[精准格挡]或[防御反击]时，招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
After activating Special Attack: Shockwave Shield Bash, press [Special Attack] to activate:
Thrusts forward, dealing Physical DMG.
If Perfect Block or Retaliation is not triggered, the Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill when Perfect Block or Retaliation is triggered.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：招架反击
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
使用盾牌向前方进行打击，随后发动强力刺击，造成大量物理伤害；
若在招式发动初期受到敌方攻击，或通过盾牌打击触发[破招]时，将触发[精准格挡]，抵挡此次攻击伤害，并挥盾反击；触发[精准格挡]后，点按 【强化特殊技键】 ，可以发动[强化特殊技：超强力盾击]，且无需消耗能量；
招式发动后，凯撒将进入格挡架势，期间自身受到的伤害降低40%，受到敌人攻击时将持盾格挡并被击退，随后点按 【特殊技键】 或 【强化特殊技键】 ，可以触发[防御反击]，发动[特殊技：喧嚣直刺]或[强化特殊技：超强力盾击]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Strikes forward with the shield, followed by a powerful thrust, dealing massive Physical DMG.
If Caesar is hit by an enemy at the beginning of the skill activation or an Interrupt is triggered with the shield strike, it will trigger Perfect Block, negating incoming damage once and countering with a shield attack. After triggering Perfect Block, press [EX Special Attack] to activate EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash without consuming energy.
After using the skill, Caesar enters a guard stance, reducing incoming damage by 40%. When attacked by an enemy, Caesar blocks the attack and is knocked back. Press [Special Attack] or [EX Special Attack] to trigger Retaliation and activate Special Attack: Roaring Thrust or EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：超强力盾击
ex.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Overpowered Shield Bash
ex.description:
[强化特殊技：招架反击]发动后，能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
使用盾牌向前方进行打击，造成大量物理伤害；
若在招式发动初期受到敌方攻击，或通过盾牌打击触发[破招]时，将触发[精准格挡]，抵挡此次攻击伤害，并返还发动招式所消耗的能量；
以[精准格挡]或[防御反击]的方式发动时，无法再次触发[精准格挡]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
After activating EX Special Attack: Parry Counter, with enough energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Strikes forward with the shield, dealing massive Physical DMG.
If Caesar is hit by an enemy at the beginning of the skill activation or an Interrupt is triggered with the shield strike, it will trigger Perfect Block, negating incoming damage once and recovering the Energy used to activate the skill.
When the skill is activated through Perfect Block or Retaliation, it cannot trigger Perfect Block again.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ex.name: 攻防转换
ex.description: 凯撒触发[精准格挡]、[防御反击]或[招架支援]时，自身冲击力提升9%，持续3秒。
ex.descriptionEn: When Caesar triggers a Perfect Block, Retaliation, or Defensive Assist, her impact is increased by 9% for 3s.

ultimate.name: 终结技：暴君猛击
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
丢出手中的盾牌对前方敌人发动强力旋转攻击，随后发动下落打击，造成大量物理伤害；
命中持有护盾的敌人时，招式造成的失衡值提升45%；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Tosses the shield forward, unleashing a powerful spinning attack on enemies in front, followed by a downward strike, dealing massive Physical DMG.
When hitting shielded enemies, the Daze dealt is increased by 45%.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：变道支援
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动刺击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Thrust at enemies in front, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

107100002.name: 普通攻击：此路不通！
107100002.description:
[支援点数]足够时，长按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
消耗1点[支援点数]，丢出手中的盾牌对四周进行攻击，造成物理伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
107100002.descriptionEn:
When there are sufficient Assist Points, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Consume 1 Assist Point to toss the shield and attack nearby enemies in all directions, dealing Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
